learn-programming: No matter if you play Minecraft or not, you can <mark class='warning'>easily learn programming</mark> through our tutorials.
mod-creation: Through the <mark class='danger'>mod creation</mark> process, you will grasp fundamental programming concepts and create your own game world.
no-experience-needed: <mark>No prior experience required</mark>. As long as you're willing, our guidance will lead you step by step through every challenge.
ready-to-start: Ready to begin? <mark class='warning'>Click the button below</mark> and let's dive into the world of programming together!
nothing-here: There's nothing here, try looking elsewhere~
not-finished-reading: Not finished reading yet (at the bottom of the page)

adjust-window-height: Also, please adjust the window height to fill the screen height, excluding the taskbar.

close-script: Please switch to the script window and click ✖ to close the script.
setup-done: Everything is set up, please click here to play.
